== English introductory product comparison ==
The April 2013 replacement makes the movement a regular move rather than an unspecified relocation. The May 2016 text specifies free landspeed movement. The regular move rules also recognize docking bay transit, which can be relevant when two docking bays are adjacent. An exterior site and a capital starship at its system are shuttling endpoints, while embarking, disembarking and docking transfers belong to the unlimited movement rules. A landspeed of zero prevents the current movement but does not by itself prevent docking bay transit between two adjacent eligible docking bay sites under the earlier wording. The current GEMP implementation uses landspeed movement. Its displayed Java card text omits ‘using landspeed’.
